sections.name: Upper back
sections.say: Y-raises fire up your upper back and pull your shoulders back where they belong.

clips.shot: Full body from behind at a 3/4 angle, standing tall, both arms raised overhead in a Y shape, shoulder blades squeezed; the upper back between the shoulder blades glows
clips.move: standing Y-raises, arms rising overhead in a Y and lowering

clips.shot: Medium shot from behind, head to hips, arms in a Y overhead, shoulder blades pulled together; the rhomboids and mid traps glow intensely
clips.move: Y-raises with a one-second squeeze at the top of each rep
clips.camera: Slow camera orbit to the right

cues: Y-raises fire up your upper back and pull your shoulders back where they belong.
Two sets of ten, and you stand taller.
